query: What is the meaning of wrongful gain and wrongful loss?

required_points: Section 2(36) defines wrongful gain as gain by unlawful means of property to which the person gaining is not legally entitled.
Section 2(37) defines wrongful loss as the loss by unlawful means of property to which the person losing it is legally entitled.
optional_points: Section 2(38) further provides that a person gains wrongfully when they retain wrongfully, not just when they acquire wrongfully; and loses wrongfully when wrongfully kept out of property as well as wrongfully deprived of it.
forbidden_points: Wrongful gain means any financial gain.
Wrongful loss means any loss of property.
